definition: a helmeted player of American football
description: On a rainy night under bright stadium floodlights, a player in a mud-smeared white uniform and a dark red helmet leaps along the white sideline and catches the brown football with both gloved hands while an opponent in gold reaches around him from behind. He tucks the ball in and runs on out of view, and an opponent rushes past. The view then shows coaches in dark jackets and teammates in white uniforms on the sideline, with a blue water cooler and the stands behind.

en.question: What is the player in white doing?

de.answer: Er fängt den Ball mit beiden Händen.
de.question: Was macht der Spieler in Weiß?

es.answer: Está atrapando el balón con las dos manos.
